title: Add graduation metadata model
prompt:
Goal: Add a small graduation metadata utility, prove its deterministic summary, and document its public behavior in code. Outcome: Add a pure graduation_metadata helper returning a deterministic dictionary for version, status, and completed phase count.
Allowed paths: src/ade/graduation.py
Acceptance: helper is pure and deterministic; invalid empty version or status is rejected
Do not modify files outside the allowed paths.
